components.name: Action button
components.css: .tv-action { font:500 20px Inter,Arial,sans-serif; background:var(--text,#f5f5f3); color:var(--ground,#101112); border:0; border-radius:12px; padding:22px 24px; } .tv-action:focus { outline:4px solid var(--focus,#fafaf8); outline-offset:6px; }

narrative.northStar: Cinematic scenic wallpaper, large clock, quiet app dock
narrative.overview: A couch-distance TV launcher with local scenic artwork, live weather, editable tiles, saved preferences and idle mode.

rules.name: Immediate remote response
rules.body: No transition delay on keyboard navigation

donts: Do not invent weather or watch history
